title: Pin plain-english-styles at v0.2.0 and re-verify the federated baseline
summary: plain-english-styles released v0.2.0 (PES-12; tag fe3dcee8 peels to 2a06e85f, which is origin/main and dev). Move the marketplace entry ref from v0.1.0 to v0.2.0 and update the scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json baseline in the same change. Floor work (DEC-182, DEC-226): pin and baseline.

acceptanceCriteria.text: marketplace.json plain-english-styles source.ref is v0.2.0 and nothing else in the entry changed
baseline records ref v0.2.0 with subtree SHAs resolved through the git-database API at bump time
node scripts/check-federated-content.mjs passes for the entry and the PR checks are green

finalSummary: Per PR #229: moved the plain-english-styles pin v0.1.0 -> v0.2.0 (tag object fe3dcee8 peels to 2a06e85f, the release commit of PES-12) and re-verified the baseline, now recording three subtrees (output-styles 7d606fc7, skills 62975cdd, hooks ac8a05f3) resolved through the git-database API. check-federated-content.mjs and check-federated-pins.mjs both passed 9 of 9 locally; the required checks (check manifests, Tracker integrity, lore check) were green on head 16808a6d. The negative case for the baseline check was not run.
